dedupe_keys.name: erf energy research and forecasting atmospheric model

description: ERF is a high-performance atmospheric model developed with renewable-energy applications in mind. It simulates mesoscale and microscale flow, including wind conditions relevant to turbines, using the AMReX adaptive-mesh framework on CPUs or GPUs. Users define weather and terrain inputs, physics and domain; geographic coverage, resolution and simulation period follow those choices. Its source and build instructions are public. The own LICENSE text has BSD-style redistribution conditions plus an enhancement provision, so the draft records these custom terms instead of assuming standard BSD-3-Clause. Wind fields can help test wind-farm performance, plan generation or study severe-weather exposure of power assets. A caveat is that the atmospheric parameterizations and input data must be validated for the chosen site, while computing requirements can be high. No directly related catalogue record was established. The JOSS description, repository and licence were inspected without compiling ERF or fetching weather files.
name: ERF Energy Research and Forecasting atmospheric model
